name: Statuspage Cloud
description: Statuspage Cloud is Atlassian's hosted service-status platform for publishing component health, incidents, maintenance, and uptime information.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Statuspage with a customer API token, then let agents read bounded component and incident summaries or update one component status under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: STATUSPAGE_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Statuspage API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy an API token authorized for the intended Statuspage.

credentialRequirements.name: STATUSPAGE_PAGE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Statuspage page ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind this connection to one exact Statuspage page ID.

capabilities.label: Read status
capabilities.description: List bounded component and incident summaries for one exact Statuspage.

capabilities.label: Update component status
capabilities.description: Set one exact component to one documented operational status.

allowed.label: List components
allowed.description: List at most 25 bounded component summaries for the bound page.

allowed.label: List incidents
allowed.description: List at most 25 bounded incident summaries for the bound page.

approvalRequired.label: Update component status
approvalRequired.description: Set one exact component to one documented operational status; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Create incidents or notify subscribers
blocked.description: Incident creation and notification delivery are unavailable in this bounded connector.

blocked.label: Administer Statuspage
blocked.description: Deleting resources, managing subscribers, users, templates, metrics, access groups, and account configuration is blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every component-status change requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected reads and component-status changes run without Relay per-action approval; page binding, provider authority, bounds, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts page-bound read and approved component-status tools while keeping the API token server-side.
Railway mounts page-bound read and approved component-status tools while keeping the API token server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer enters a Statuspage API token and the one exact page ID that Relay may read and update.

evidence.supports: Atlassian documents the fixed api.statuspage.io/v1 origin, API-token authorization, one-request-per-second rate limit, 420/429 responses, and the current REST resource catalog.
The official component reference documents bounded pagination, component summaries, exact component reads, and PATCH status updates under one page ID.
The official incident reference documents page-bound incident lists with a maximum of 100 rows; Relay further limits this to 25 minimized summaries.
